title: Size match for container walk: per-dimension tolerance, not area and not exact
trigger: Walking up the DOM to find the farthest same-size container — area-based comparison accepts a same-height-different-width shell, while exact per-dimension match rejects a shell that is slightly taller because it owns the control bar
principle: Compare each dimension independently with a small relative tolerance (e.g. 10%). Area-based tolerance (|area-ref|/ref <= t) and area-ratio bounds ([0.5,1.5]) accept containers that match one axis but diverge on the other — a wider shell with the same height has an area ratio inside the band. Exact per-dimension match (Math.round(w)===vw) is too strict — a player container that includes the control bar is a few px taller than the video, so exact match rejects it and Split View wraps just the bare video, leaving controls outside the stage. Per-dimension tolerance (wDiff <= tol && hDiff <= tol) accepts the control-bar overhead (typically 1–10% of video height) while rejecting layout containers that are significantly wider/taller (33%+).

cases.context: themoviebox: video 1226×690, .player-container 1635×690 (same height, +33% width). Area ratio 1.33 is inside the [0.5,1.5] control-shell band, so the isControlShell branch accepts it — Split View moves the wider container and the video stage layout breaks.

kisskh: video 1103×913, .videoplayer 1103×922 (same width, +9px height for control bar). Exact per-dimension match (Math.round(h)===vh) rejects .videoplayer because 922 !== 913 — Split View wraps just the video, controls are outside the stage and span the full viewport width.

applyFor: Player container / player-shell discovery walking up from a <video> or <iframe>
Fullscreen target selection where the target must visually match the media element on both axes but include control bars
Any 'find the farthest same-size ancestor' walk where 'same size' means both dimensions within tolerance, not the product (area)
Split View / Player Mode container resolution on sites where the player shell is slightly larger than the video because of control bars
